name: Umakado Mirei
source:
A childhood friend of Atsuko Himega that helps Shiomi in resolving the case of the "Prophecy" and the "Rabbit Slaughter".

[spoiler]She's actually the mastermind of both cases, being the one that tampered with the software that the computer club made and killed all the rabbits in the school, all for the sake of bullying Himega and making her feel lonely.[/spoiler]
translation:
A childhood friend of Atsuko Himega that helps Shiomi in resolving the case of the "Prophecy" and the "Rabbit Slaughter".

[spoiler]She's actually the mastermind of both cases, being the one that tampered with the software that the computer club made and killed all the rabbits in the school, all for the sake of bullying Himega and making her feel lonely.[/spoiler]
